query: VAEDecodeTiled on MiniMax H3 video fails with 'to() received an invalid combination of arguments - got (NestedTensor)'.

desired.outcome: Maintainer rattus128 (C3): the MiniMax VAE has built-in tiling (trained tile size, <8GB VRAM) - use the standard VAE Decode node, the tiled node is incompatible. LIQUIDMIND111 (C4) confirms standard decode works.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct.
